name: SkinScores
description: Dermatology scoring workspace with explicit-input safeguards, evidence citations, and longitudinal clinical workflows.
outcome: Calculate and document dermatology severity and outcome measures without silent default inputs.
privacySummary: Account-backed features use Firebase. Do not enter identifiable patient data unless the deployed environment and institutional policy explicitly permit it.

review.note: Calculator-level provenance and clinician vetting exist; the public catalog does not yet expose one portfolio-wide review date.

name: Rheum–Derm Immune Atlas
description: Evidence-graded atlas connecting immune pathways, manifestations, treatments, and source trails across rheumatologic–dermatologic disease.
outcome: Trace disease mechanisms and treatment relationships while preserving evidence boundaries and provenance.
privacySummary: Static evidence application. No account or patient data is required.

review.note: Release QA includes provenance, relationship-state, accessibility, responsive, and visual verification.

name: Interactive Dermatology Mind Maps
description: Searchable dermatology concept maps with atlas, diagram, comparison, annotation, and export views.
outcome: Explore dermatology topics as structured diagnostic, mechanistic, and treatment maps.
privacySummary: Static educational application. Search and annotations remain in the browser.

review.note: Schema validation is enforced; topic-level clinical review dates and assertion-level provenance are being added.

name: DermatoTarget Atlas
description: Reproducible public-data workbench for dermatology target prioritization across genetics, tissue context, trials, druggability, and literature.
outcome: Inspect and compare target-development hypotheses with decomposable scores and sensitivity analyses.
privacySummary: Static public-data research artifact. No patient data is accepted.

review.note: Hypothesis-generating evidence integration; not clinical guidance or causal proof.

name: Clinisched
description: Firebase-backed residency scheduling with constraints, conflict checks, auto-scheduling, publication workflows, and analytics.
outcome: Build and review residency schedules with explicit constraints and auditable schedule changes.
privacySummary: Authentication is required for institutional scheduling data. The application is not intended for patient information.

review.note: Operational software; release acceptance focuses on authorization, constraint correctness, auditability, fairness, and recovery.

name: JeopaGen
description: Source-grounded Jeopardy-style game studio with document ingestion, human review, and offline HTML and PowerPoint exports.
outcome: Turn source documents into reviewable classroom games with source-grounded questions and local exports.
privacySummary: AI actions send selected source content to the configured Gemini provider. API keys are session-scoped; do not upload protected health information.

review.note: Publication remains unlisted until a durable non-expiring release channel is committed to the website source.

name: RAMIE — Realtime Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer
description: Feature-rich dermatology research prototype for transcription, multimodal consultation support, differential generation, management drafting, and structured note creation.
outcome: Explore an end-to-end dermatology documentation and decision-support prototype with clinician review at every output stage.
privacySummary: Audio, images, transcripts, and prompts may be sent to the configured RAMIE backend and model provider. The public demo is not approved for protected health information.

review.note: Research and demonstration prototype. Outputs require clinician verification and are not medical advice or autonomous clinical decisions.

name: Rheum–Derm Clinical Trials Evidence Dashboard
description: Searchable dashboard covering 214 landmark and emerging rheumatologic–dermatologic studies and development programs.
outcome: Compare trials, interventions, endpoints, routes, and reported outcomes across rheum–derm disease.
privacySummary: Static evidence dashboard. No account or patient data is required.

review.note: The dashboard distinguishes research evidence from clinical guidance; normalized source-record publication remains a release requirement.

name: Biologic Monitoring Dashboard
description: Searchable reference for baseline screening, follow-up laboratories, safety counseling, and hold criteria for systemic dermatology therapies.
outcome: Look up treatment-specific baseline and follow-up monitoring with visible source and review status.
privacySummary: Static reference. It does not require or store patient identifiers.

review.note: Content remains accessible with a prominent review-due warning while agent-level source reconciliation is completed.

name: Dermoscopy LLM Evaluation Dashboard
description: Research companion for multimodal LLM performance across dermoscopic diagnoses, prompting strategies, cost, latency, and error types.
outcome: Inspect model and prompt performance while keeping unique-image and repeated-evaluation denominators explicit.
privacySummary: Static aggregate research dashboard. No image upload or patient data entry is supported.

review.note: Results apply only to the evaluated model snapshots, prompts, and 100 unique images.

name: Dermatopathology Navigator
description: Dermatopathology learning environment with pattern review, comparison, flashcards, spaced repetition, quizzes, and source-linked differentials.
outcome: Practice recognizing and distinguishing dermatopathology patterns with structured review tools.
privacySummary: Core study functions run in the browser. Optional AI functions may send selected content to a configured provider; do not enter patient data.

review.note: Educational content requires item-level image/source provenance and a current clinical review ledger.

name: Skinoculars
description: Interactive 3D skin-anatomy and disease visualization with layers, guided tours, comparison, quiz, wound-healing, and XR modes.
outcome: Explore skin anatomy and schematic disease-associated changes in interactive 3D.
privacySummary: Browser-based educational visualization. No account or patient data entry is required.

review.note: Disease transforms are schematic educational representations unless a profile explicitly documents quantitative validation.

name: PDF Studio
description: Local-first PDF workspace for organization, extraction, assembly, image packets, stamping, metadata cleanup, OCR, and compression.
outcome: Edit, extract, and clean PDFs in the browser without uploading them to an application server.
privacySummary: Documents are processed locally in the browser. Secure redaction is not claimed unless underlying content removal is independently verified.

review.note: Acceptance focuses on local-only processing, output integrity, malformed-file handling, accessibility, and large-file recovery.

name: KSA Sovereign Credit Analytics
description: Private sovereign-credit dashboard for Saudi Eurobond, CDS, benchmark, and scenario monitoring.
outcome: Monitor source-aware sovereign-credit signals inside a protected private deployment.
privacySummary: Cloudflare Access protects the private service; licensed market data and secrets must remain outside the public website repository.

review.note: Acceptance focuses on access control, source timestamps, licensed-data boundaries, reproducibility, backups, and fail-closed operation.

name: Table Ledger — D&D Character Console
description: Private character console with rules-aware calculations, actions, defenses, spells, inventory, builder, journal, and local persistence.
outcome: Manage and audit tabletop character state with explicit source-snapshot versus strict-rules modes.
privacySummary: Local browser state only. The route is intentionally unlisted and noindexed.

review.note: Must not gate deployment of the professional portfolio once separated into its own release workflow.

name: Taskboard
description: Internal task-management dashboard with Firebase-backed projects, tasks, deadlines, and views.
outcome: Manage internal projects and deadlines in a private authenticated workspace.
privacySummary: Firebase-backed internal data. The route requires explicit authorization and must not rely on obscurity or noindex alone.

review.note: Migration to a separately authenticated deployment is required before sensitive use.

name: Dermatology MCQ Benchmark Dashboard
description: Unlisted research dashboard for model-generated dermatology multiple-choice question benchmarking.
outcome: Inspect aggregate and item-level MCQ generation quality across models and judges.
privacySummary: Static aggregate research artifact; no patient data entry is supported.

review.note: Public promotion requires independent human adjudication and payload partitioning.

name: Dermatology MCQ Dual-Judge Evaluation
description: Unlisted dual-judge analysis of generated dermatology MCQs, including agreement, fatal flaws, and per-model performance.
outcome: Analyze automated-judge agreement and clinically material MCQ defects.
privacySummary: Static evaluation artifact; no patient data entry is supported.

review.note: Automated-judge rankings must not be presented as human-validated item quality.

name: Egypt AI & Technology Opportunity Portfolio
description: Private strategy dashboard covering venture concepts, roadmap, partners, evidence, and source materials.
outcome: Review an evidence-linked opportunity portfolio and its execution assumptions.
privacySummary: Unlisted static strategy material. Sensitive distribution requires authenticated hosting rather than noindex alone.

review.note: Versioned assumptions, evidence currency, and access control are required for external distribution.

name: Dermie VC Preparation Packet
description: Unlisted financial, milestone, competitive, and demo-preparation packet for Dermie.
outcome: Review a versioned private fundraising and product-positioning packet.
privacySummary: Contains potentially sensitive commercial assumptions. It must move behind authentication before broader distribution.

review.note: Confidentiality classification, versioning, and access control are required.

name: Wound Care Webpages
description: Historical 2019 wound-care reference preserved for archival and methodological context.
outcome: Review a historical artifact with an explicit warning that it is not a current clinical reference.
privacySummary: Static historical artifact; no data entry is required.

review.note: Must remain visibly archived until rebuilt and clinically re-reviewed from current sources.

name: DermAI Reference Generator
description: Archived documentation for an incomplete agentic dermatology-reference extraction pipeline.
outcome: Inspect historical design documentation; no active reference-generation service is provided.
privacySummary: Documentation only; no active application or data processing.

review.note: Any revival must validate DOI, PMID, correction, and retraction status before emitting a citation.

name: AI Dermatology Scribe — Legacy HTML
description: Original static scribe prototype retained for historical comparison with RAMIE.
outcome: Inspect the historical prototype and follow the current RAMIE research-prototype route for active work.
privacySummary: Historical static prototype; do not enter patient data.

review.note: Retained only for historical comparison.
